Keep white paint and other solid foreground colors opaque, preserve fine edges, and retain partial alpha only for genuinely translucent material or soft shadows in the reference. No chroma background, baked-in checkerboard, or matte. Output a transparent PNG cutout. Region: ink-drawn grass tufts along the hero foot, right of the dog.
 Draw about eight separate tufts of grass in loose ink line, spread evenly across the entire width of the image in one low band, each tuft a few blades, varied in size; the chartreuse felt ground is the page's own surface and must be fully transparent.
